verdict.rationale: Gusto's official CLI documents a telemetry opt-out. Its API requests carry anonymous usage headers (install ID and command), and setting GUSTO_TELEMETRY=0 omits both. This is a direct, first-party control, but it is scoped to the CLI only, and the evidence is a single README mention. missing for 10: telemetry/usage-tracking opt-out for the broader Gusto product (web app, SDKs, MCP server), first-party privacy docs describing what is collected and the full extent of the opt-out, independent or hands-on verification that GUSTO_TELEMETRY=0 actually suppresses the headers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking

citations.quote: API requests carry anonymous usage headers (X-Gusto-CLI-Install-Id, X-Gusto-CLI-Command); GUSTO_TELEMETRY=0 omits both — a documented telemetry opt-out.
